channel.title: Operation Ouch!
channel.desc: The doctors attempt an experiment of superhero proportions to show why your ribcage is the perfect design. Ouch Patient Indie tells us about life with congenital glaucoma, and Dr Xand finds out how 3D printing is helping surgeons perform tricky operations. Meanwhile, in the emergency department, one patient has a rock in their ear and another has swallowed a coin.
